changelog: [Never Segment]: added five generalized trap rules targeting the wrong-boundary errors the critic found — never split right before a proper noun's first mention (keep naming context attached), never sever a concessive/contrastive clause from the result clause whose lexical choices depend on it, never split a quantity/degree phrase (ほど/くらい/ぐらい + noun) from its clause, never split between a 末に/末、 result-framing clause and its conclusion, and never split right after a temporal/conditional conjunction (と/ば/たら) when the next clause contains an idiom whose rendering depends on the condition.

[Decision Procedure]: added a final verification step requiring the output to always contain every character of the original input with only <SEG> tags inserted, explicitly forbidding empty, partial, or rewritten output, to close the format_violation gap the critic flagged (defaulting to zero tags rather than corrupting or dropping text).
